prompt_rules: If the wish needs no electronics (holder, stand, organiser, planter, figurine, decorative vessel, shop fixture), design kind "printed": no features, no electronics, no behaviour, and say plainly it has no electronics.
Printed PETG is not food-safe and not for hot liquids: a teapot, cup or bowl is decorative or a planter.
No threads, filters or load ratings are promised; fit is a physical check.
